import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] p = new long[17];

    static long solve(long n, int len) {
        long q = n / p[len];
        long r = n % p[len];
        if (r == 0) {
            return q * len;
        } else {
            return q * len + Math.min(solve(r, len - 1), len + solve(p[len] - r, len - 1));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long ans = solve(n, 16);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
